items.title: Billy Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: But I’d been around the world with Dizzy’s band before that.

ctx.x: And did you get to travel overseas with Basie?
Yeah. I went to Europe with Basie in ‘59 I think. But I’d been around the world with Dizzy’s band before that.
Yeah. It was a State Department tour? Is that what that was?
